annotations.title: How the ASPERN rating is made

description: How the ASPERN rating is made, and how the rated vaults are spread across its letters. The scale (A+ … D, the letter family tied to the report’s levels: low A, moderate B, high C, severe D), the eight components with their weights, inputs, thresholds and what leaves each not rated, the share ladder for collateral, borrowers and oracles, the overall rule, the caps, the band ceiling, what it cannot see, version and changelog. `distribution` counts vaults by overall letter, by component letter and by cap over the documents of the last two days; `validation` is the sensitivity study of the rule (caps, weights, unknowns, illustrative v2 weights), not a loss backtest; nothing is named. Free.
name: rating_methodology

distribution.description: snapshot (asOf, population, documents, excluded, filter, says: the one set every count is of), vaults, rated, notRated, byRating, byComponent, caps, byCoverage, at, says. sum(byRating) = rated and rated + notRated = vaults. Null where it could not be counted just now.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

method.description: version, scale, levelRanges, components, shareLadder, transparencyLadder, ageRule, overall, caps, componentDCap (what the D cap means, why, and that concentration most often sets it), bandCeiling, relationToBand, cannotSee, versioning (a change of weights or rules is a new version and recomputes every rating), changelog (every version with its weights), disclaimer.

validation.description: The shadow sensitivity study of the published rule (counts only, no vault named, no shadow letter): how often each cap is active, lowers and sets the letter and by how many notches; the share of letters that change with each component left out, each weight moved (±5 points, half, ×1.5), unknowns at worst or best, the audit’s illustrative v2 weights, one root cause counted once, and a wrapper’s indirect lending counted as not assessed; one-root-cause and allocation × severity counts; limits (not a loss backtest, no calibrated probability of default); pointInTimeSnapshot: what a future backtest must freeze each day and its target events.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it, each {code, message, says} with message and says the same sentence. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
